I am compelled to write a positive review for this game even though I refunded it. I only played the game for a little over 60 minutes, but it's obvious a TON of care, thoughtfulness, and precision went into creating it! …

A game for autists by autists. I would say engineers but they really don't care enough about how a game feels. placing every wire, pipe efficiency from laying longer units, making number go up in plant genetics. …
As a real life engineer I can tell you that designing anything without proper manuals and diagrams is as frustrating in real life as in this game. …
真好玩，制作人发个力啊，我希望能在有生之年看到KSP+Stationeers，这样如果我起飞的货物多我就可以在着陆的时候有更多的资源了。而且星球的基地建设好了后可以返回轨道仓去探索新的星球。
比较纯粹的沙盒内容很丰富，就是新手引导比较弱，进度推动力稍显薄弱（在火星死磕相变分离大气，搞了好几天，IC代码写了一大堆，结果其他内容都快忘了）。 …
差评，因为这个游戏对我的要求太高了， 有个成就甚至要求在一场游戏凑齐5个玩家，简直丧心病狂 我连两个都凑不齐。。
